Markets.title: US stocks: US market sinks as bond yields rise, Walmart results disappoint
Markets.summary: US stocks fell as bond yields rose and Walmart reported disappointing results. The consumer discretionary sector, including Amazon and Tesla, and fuel-sensitive cruise lines like Royal Caribbean and Carnival suffered major declines.

Markets.title: Shein targets September 1 for Hong Kong IPO: Report
Markets.summary: Shein has delayed its Hong Kong initial public offering to September 1 amid slowing growth and rising costs. The company is targeting a reduced valuation of $26 billion to $27 billion.

Markets.title: US Treasury's Bessent says upsized bond buybacks could increase further
Markets.summary: US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent announced that upsized bond buybacks could increase further to improve market liquidity and economic confidence. Simultaneously, the Treasury is pursuing a fiscal consolidation initiative to achieve hundreds of billions in savings.

Markets.title: St. Louis Fed's Musalem says on CNBC he won't prejudge rate call view for September FOMC
Markets.summary: St. Louis Fed President Alberto Musalem stated that keeping interest rates higher remains appropriate because inflation is still above the central bank's two percent target. He emphasized taking a steady approach and carefully evaluating data before the September FOMC meeting rather than prejudging the rate decision.

Markets.title: Upstox begins talks with investment banks for $350-400 million IPO; crosses 2 crore customers
Markets.summary: Investment platform Upstox is in talks with investment banks to raise $350 to $400 million through an upcoming initial public offering. The proposed IPO will consist of both new shares and an offer-for-sale as the company surpasses two crore customers.

Markets.title: Augmont Enterprises mops up Rs 246 crore in anchor round ahead of IPO; Nomura, HDFC MF among investors
Markets.summary: Augmont Enterprises raised Rs 246.3 crore from anchor investors, including Nomura and HDFC Mutual Fund, ahead of its IPO opening on August 21. The company plans to use the fresh issue proceeds for working capital and inventory before its shares list on the NSE and BSE on August 31.

Geo-Political.title: US says sanctions will 'squash' Iran's economy and 'collapse' its regime
Geo-Political.summary: US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent stated that impending US sanctions will devastate Iran's economy and cause its regime to collapse. He also warned international allies that they must choose whether to support the United States or oppose it.

Geo-Political.title: UK, France, Germany, Italy and Canada condemn Israel's West Bank settlement project
Geo-Political.summary: The UK, France, Germany, Italy, and Canada have jointly condemned Israel's plans to expand settlements in the occupied West Bank. This international pressure targets a strategically vital area of the territory.

Geo-Political.title: Russia 'purposefully' hit critical infrastructure in latest strikes, Kyiv mayor says
Geo-Political.summary: At least 17 people were killed in overnight Russian strikes targeting Ukraine's capital. Kyiv mayor Vitali Klitschko stated that the attacks purposefully hit critical infrastructure, disrupting the city's hot water supply.

Geo-Political.title: Dozens dead after boat capsizes in north-western Nigeria
Geo-Political.summary: Dozens of people died after a boat capsized in north-western Nigeria's Sokoto state. Many of the victims are feared to be children.

Geo-Political.title: Como mayor hit by electric bike and issues blanket ban in Italian city
Geo-Political.summary: Como Mayor Alessandro Rapinese banned electric bikes in the Italian city after being struck by one himself. He stated that the blanket prohibition was implemented to ensure public safety.

Geo-Political.title: Assad officer extradited to Syria on war crimes charges for first time
Geo-Political.summary: Lebanon has extradited former Syrian General Adel Issa to Syria to face war crimes charges. This marks the first time a former regime officer has been sent back as the Syrian government intensifies its pursuit of wanted officials.

AI & Tech.summary: An author discovered their WordPress SaaS course was recommended as the top result when asking ChatGPT for the best course on the subject. The placement was achieved without any paid advertising.

AI & Tech.summary: This guide highlights the top 10 artificial intelligence tools designed to revolutionize content creation in 2025. These essential technologies help digital creators stay ahead of industry trends and streamline their workflows.

AI & Tech.summary: LimeWire has evolved into a generative AI platform that allows users to create digital content. The tool also provides features for creators to share and monetize their AI-generated work.

Data & Insights.title: India allows duty-free sugar imports as prices surge
Data & Insights.summary: India has eliminated its sugar import duty to reduce record-high domestic prices. This decision follows earlier government actions that banned sugar exports and tightened stock holding limits.

Data & Insights.title: Core sector growth eases to 5.4% in July from 6% in June; iron ore, cement drive expansion
Data & Insights.summary: India's core infrastructure sector growth slowed to 5.4% in July from a revised 6% in June. This expansion was primarily driven by the iron ore, cement, and electricity sectors.

Data & Insights.title: RBI’s $50 billion boost may not be enough to lift the rupee | Here's why
Data & Insights.summary: Despite an anticipated $50 billion balance-of-payments surplus in FY27, experts warn that the Indian rupee may not strengthen. This outcome depends on whether inflows from the RBI's FCNR deposits enter the market or are absorbed as reserves.

Data & Insights.title: RBI's rate-setting panel hints at future policy tightening if inflation persists
Data & Insights.summary: RBI Governor Malhotra stated the central bank requires more clarity on persistently high prices before taking action. The rate-setting panel signaled potential policy tightening if inflation remains elevated.

Data & Insights.title: Who pays, who profits — The economics of India's toll highways landscape
Data & Insights.summary: Data from the Indian Highway Management Company shows how high-traffic routes and FASTag passes shape national toll revenues. The findings also reveal changing trends in private sector involvement across India's highway network.

Data & Insights.title: Ind-Ra raises India’s FY27 GDP growth estimate to 6.8%
Data & Insights.summary: India Ratings and Research raised India's GDP growth estimate for fiscal year 2027 to 6.8%. However, ongoing downside risks include the West Asia conflict, high inflation, currency depreciation, and weaker-than-expected capital expenditure.

India.title: China To Be India's Main Competitor Across Multiple Fields: Ex-Army Chief
India.summary: Former Army chief General Manoj Naravane stated that China will be India's primary competitor in political, economic, trade, and military sectors. This competition will span multiple domains across various fields.

India.title: To Wean Young Punjab From Drugs, Bhagwant Mann's New Recipe: Sports
India.summary: The Punjab government has announced the fourth edition of the "Khedan Wattan Punjab Diyan" sports initiative. This program aims to use sports as a key tool to steer youth away from drug use.

India.title: Video: Bengaluru Man Almost Run Over By Tanker After Bike Hits Pothole
India.summary: A Bengaluru motorcycle rider narrowly avoided being run over by a water tanker after losing control of his bike in a pothole. The tanker subsequently ran over the motorcycle, as captured in a viral video of the incident.

India.title: Speeding Aston Martin Rams, Kills Woman In Hyderabad, MP's Son Charged
India.summary: A speeding Aston Martin driven by 21-year-old Sanjush Ramesh struck and killed a 26-year-old woman in Hyderabad. The driver, son of Lingamaneni Ramesh, has been charged in connection with the fatal collision.

India.title: Fungus In Vegetables, Expired Products Found At 36 Train Stations In Karnataka
India.summary: An inspection of 36 railway stations in Karnataka revealed fungal growth on vegetables and onions. Inspectors also discovered expired products and chutney stored in unsafe plastic buckets.

India.title: 'Government Deceived Us': Jharkhand Students As Court Stays Exam Cancellation
India.summary: Jharkhand students suspended a 26-day protest after the government decided to cancel 22 recruitment exams. Now, a court stay on that cancellation has led aspirants to accuse the government of deception.

General.title: Harry and Meghan's return to UK reignites questions over security
General.summary: Harry and Meghan's surprise return to the UK has reignited questions about their security. Authorities will now need to decide what level of publicly funded protection the couple will receive.

General.title: Watch: What does Harry's return mean for his fractured relationship with William?
General.summary: Prince Harry and Prince William have maintained a fractured relationship for multiple years. It remains uncertain what impact Harry's recent return will have on this ongoing family tension.

General.title: Five key takeaways from GCSE results day 2026
General.summary: Data from GCSE results day 2026 shows an increase in exam resits and a narrower achievement gap between boys and girls. Additionally, the educational performance gap between different regions in England has widened.

General.title: French becoming more effective in stopping small boat crossings, UK says
General.summary: The Home Office credits France with intercepting hundreds of potential crossings this summer using new tactics.

General.summary: Cambridge academic Nathan Cofnas has been suspended by his university. The suspension follows accusations that he discriminated against the late professor Jason Arday by accusing him of plagiarism.
